channel.title: starwire: the day's best
channel.description: One item a day: the open source repos rising fastest, and the biggest new picks

item.title: Nov 12: craft-anything, Hookshot, dsh-superagent-prototype and 5 new picks
item.description:
Rising fastest

  1. storytold/craft-anything (~+15k a week, 28k stars): Tool for learning how software works by crafting your own version
  2. NotRexed/Hookshot (+7.8k a week, 7.8k stars): Native recompilation of an Ocarina of Time remake for Windows and Linux
  3. deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype (~+11k a week, 22k stars): Prototype of a more autonomous agent system from DeepSeek
  4. meta/astryx (+11k in 6 days, 25k stars): Customizable design system built to be used by coding agents
  5. anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager (~+5.8k a week, 6.8k stars): Cross-platform download manager written in Rust, an IDM alternative

New picks

  • podman-container-tools/podman (33k stars): Tool for managing OCI containers and pods
  • VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics (18k stars): Fast time series database and monitoring system
  • mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis (13k stars): List of LLM APIs with permanent free tiers
  • gosom/google-maps-scraper (7.9k stars): Scraper that pulls place details, ratings and reviews from Google Maps
  • ranxianglei/billion-context (6.8k stars): Context compression plugin for very long coding agent sessions

Everything else on starwire.foo
